messages:
sara: Quick async check — rolling the `new-routing-toggle` canary tomorrow 08:00 PT. Please post what you did / blockers / plan. Need infra + QA + product ack. I'll kick off iff all green.

 tom: Done: smoke tests + perf harness on slice A. No CPU spikes. Observed ~1.5% p90 latency bump under 2k req/s.

 aj: Merged: feature flag PR (https://github.com/redwood/example-repo/pull/432). Left a follow-up to tighten fallback. Blocker: waiting on infra to enable KV cache before canary.

 devops-bot: sched: Canary window reserved 2026-03-18T08:00:00-07:00 (PT). Rolling window 30m, ramp 5/25/50/100. Ops owner: @leo.

 leo: Acked. Infra: KV cache will be enabled in staging by 03:30 PT. For prod I need a runbook for quick rollback — can someone paste rollback command?

 nina: Rollback is `curl -X POST $CONSOLE/api/flags/new-routing-toggle -d '{"state":"off"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'` — ops env var stored in vault. I'll be on-call during rollout.

 kelsey: QA: completed test matrix against slice A/B. Found a minor mismatch in header handling for streaming responses (non-blocker). I'll push a fix by EOD.

 aj: Note: Canary policy needs to include fallback model variant (v2->v1) if latency > 300ms for 5m. Can we add that to the rollout policy?

 sara: Yes. @tom pls add model-fallback rule to canary config. Also add alert to PagerDuty if error rate > 0.5%.

 tom: Will do. Draft config:
```
canary:
  ramps: [5,25,50,100]
  fallback: model_v1
  metrics_alert: error_rate>0.5%
```
Pushing as PR now.

 leo: Ops checklist: cache enabled, healthcheck endpoint /_hc returns ok, pdarn runbooks attached. I'll run a smoke after first 5%.
Link to dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/canary-new-routing

 nina: I'll run post-deploy regression suite (15m). Ping me in thread when first 5% is live.

 sara: Good. Final ask: anyone expecting breaking client changes? @kelsey?

 kelsey: No breaking changes. Only header normalization fix — clients should be fine.

 aj: FYI there's one open CR in the PR that I want to address but it's low risk. If timing is tight we can merge and patch on canary.

 tom: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/example-repo/pull/433 — requesting review from @aj @kelsey

 sara: :thumbsup: If no objections by 22:00 PT I'll greenlight canary. I'll post 'GO' here.
